latestVersion.changelog:
- Added documentation for the new /playwright/pipeline endpoint, supporting chained actions and snapshots in a single request.
- Recommended using the compact Playwright snapshot mode ("playwrightSnapshotMode: 'compact'") for high-frequency analysis scenarios in /playwright/page-dom.
- Updated suggested parameter usage for /playwright/page-dom and described preferred snapshot and selector options.
- Recommended /playwright/pipeline over sequential /page-dom and /run when both pre- and post-action page analysis are needed.
- Expanded and clarified the relation table for Playwright endpoints, now including /playwright/pipeline.
